title: Rodrigo Duterte expected to appear in 4th ICC status conference

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte is once again expected to appear before the International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III on Tuesday for the fourth status conference in his crimes against humanity case. Duterte is expected to attend the conference as he has yet to waive his right to attend the hearing as granted by the Chamber. Should he attend, this will mark Duterte’s second personal appearance in the court proceedings.
